limitations: Oracle cannot be a game solution.
Noiseless oracle with identical inputs is a pairing/null test, not evidence of denoising.
Positive-noise oracle tests isolate input-noise-induced response bias.
Synthetic planar geometry, not game water.
One null repeat is a diagnostic, not a population confidence bound.
